summary: The relevant recent arXiv set is led by CMS oxygen-oxygen strange-hadron measurements, lattice-QCD crossover thermodynamics, non-Gaussian heavy-quark transport, quarkonium open-system transport, jet-wake anisotropy, CGC numerical acceleration, and validation-oriented AI/ML papers for trigger deployment, simulation-to-data adaptation, and statistical robustness.
strongest_paper: CMS observation of enhanced Lambda/K0S production in oxygen-oxygen collisions is the cleanest experimental heavy-ion highlight and provides a concrete small-system QGP/coalescence test.

papers.title: Observation of enhanced baryon production using strange hadrons in oxygen-oxygen collisions
papers.abstract: CMS measures K0S and Lambda spectra in oxygen-oxygen and proton-proton collisions at 5.36 TeV. The Lambda-to-K0S ratio is enhanced in OO relative to pp, while K0S spectral modification follows inclusive charged-hadron behavior, suggesting radial-flow and coalescence-like physics in a smaller system.

papers.title: The QCD crossover temperature and curvature coefficient from unbiased exponential resummation at physical quark masses in (2+1)-flavor lattice QCD
papers.abstract: The paper applies unbiased exponential resummation to finite-density baryon susceptibility and obtains pseudocritical temperatures near 158-160 MeV, with curvature estimates consistent with previous lattice-QCD scaling and Taylor-expansion results.

papers.title: Heavy quark transport in quark-gluon plasma beyond the non-relativistic limit
papers.authors: Krishna Rajagopal, Bruno Scheihing-Hitschfeld, Urs Achim Wiedemann
papers.abstract: This SQM proceeding argues for heavy-quark transport descriptions that retain non-Gaussian momentum-transfer information rather than relying on quasiparticle or Gaussian-kick assumptions, with a demonstrative example in strongly coupled N=4 SYM.

papers.title: From the universal Lindblad equation to Boltzmann equations: in-QGP quarkonium dynamics
papers.authors: Aoumeur Daddi Hammou, Pol Bernard Gossiaux
papers.abstract: The authors derive semiclassical singlet-octet Boltzmann equations from universal Lindblad equations for in-QGP quarkonium dynamics, going beyond the small-dipole approximation and identifying an additional octet continuum transition term.

papers.title: The elliptic wind on jet wakes in high-energy heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors: Kai-Yi Wu, Zhong Yang, Xin-Nian Wang
papers.abstract: The paper predicts azimuthally dependent jet-wake broadening in non-central heavy-ion collisions and proposes in-plane/out-of-plane gamma-jet soft-hadron correlations as observables sensitive to elliptic flow and QGP viscosity.

papers.title: Fourier Transforms of Color Glass Condensate Multi-Wilson-Line Correlators via Filon Quadrature
papers.authors: Haowu Duan, Si-Wei Dai, Cong Yi, Wenbin Zhao
papers.abstract: A Filon-type quadrature and GPU implementation accelerate oscillatory Hankel transforms of CGC multi-Wilson-line correlators, with validation on DIS dijet cross sections beyond the correlation-limit approximation and public code.

papers.title: Symbolic Regression for Interpretable Emulation of Proton Collective Flow in Intermediate-Energy Heavy-Ion Collisions
papers.authors: Nicholas Cox, Xavier Grundler, Bao-An Li
papers.abstract: Symbolic-regression emulators reproduce IBUU proton collective-flow observables with DNN-comparable accuracy and provide analytic forward and inverse relations involving the in-medium nucleon-nucleon cross-section modification factor.

papers.title: Distilling Normalizing Flows for Real-Time Anomaly Detection at the LHC
papers.authors: Tara P. A. Tahseen, Noah Clarke Hall, Nikolaos Konstantinidis, Paula Martinez Suarez
papers.abstract: A conditional normalizing-flow likelihood is distilled into lightweight decision-tree and quantized neural-network students for FPGA-compatible real-time LHC anomaly detection, including missing-feature handling.

papers.title: Safe Domain Adaptation for Physics: Overcoming Nuisances, Label Shifts, and Simulation Priors
papers.abstract: The paper shows that adversarial domain adaptation can encode wrong simulation priors when target-label distributions differ, and proposes reweighted adaptive domain adaptation plus label-free model selection on an air-shower benchmark.

papers.title: VERaiPHY - Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics
papers.authors: Gaia Grosso, Ramon Winterhalder, Lydia Brenner, Louis Lyons, Tilman Plehn
papers.abstract: This PHYSTAT opening article lays statistical and ML foundations for a series on validation, uncertainty quantification, robustness, and deployment standards for AI in physics.

papers.title: Green BOA: Determining the environmental break-even point for ML-based data compression
papers.authors: Caterina Doglioni, Akshat Gupta, Thomas Elliott, Hanzila Hussain, Sanjiban Sengupta
papers.abstract: A 3-page lightning-talk summary estimates the environmental break-even point for ML-based lossless compression by comparing ML training/inference carbon cost with storage savings.
